# Petition consent wording — version `2026-08-v1`

This is the exact wording shown to a signer at the moment they signed, for every
row in `public.petition_signatures` whose `consent_version = '2026-08-v1'`.

**Do not edit this file.** POPIA requires demonstrable consent, and its
evidentiary value depends on it being an immutable record of what was actually
on screen. If the on-page wording changes, add a NEW file with a new version
string and bump `CONSENT_VERSION` in
`supabase/functions/sign-petition/index.ts` in the same commit.

- **Surface:** `/events/stunning-pigs`, petition section (`#petition`)
- **Component:** `src/pages/events/wwpl/PetitionForm.tsx`
- **In force from:** 1 August 2026

## Marketing consent checkbox

Unchecked by default. Ticking it is optional and is *not* required to sign —
signing is the petition act; this checkbox governs marketing contact only.

> Keep me posted on the campaign and the premiere.

## Privacy statement shown beneath the submit button

> Your details are used for this petition only. Signatures are collected by
> Omni Wellness Media and shared with campaign partners Beauty Without Cruelty
> and G.A.R.D., who present them to regulators and industry. Never sold. See our
> privacy policy.

## What the signer is told elsewhere on the page

From the petition section body copy:

> You don't need a ticket to add your voice. Our petition asks South African
> regulators and industry to review high-concentration CO₂ gas stunning and
> commit to achievable, more humane alternatives. Every signature is presented
> with the campaign after the premiere.

## Confirmation email

Sent to every new signature (see `sendConfirmationEmail` in the edge function).
It restates who collected the data, who the responsible parties are, that first
name / surname / city may appear on the presented petition while the email
address is never published, and gives the address to use for access,
correction or erasure requests.
